raw.question: show release statistics for the most recent release

naive.question: show release statistics for the most recent release
naive.sql:
SELECT *
FROM rnacen.release_stats
WHERE this_release = (SELECT MAX(this_release) FROM rnacen.release_stats)

pq_v1.question: show release statistics for the most recent release
pq_v1.sql:
SELECT rs.*
FROM rnacen.release_stats rs
JOIN (
    SELECT dbid, MAX(this_release) AS max_release
    FROM rnacen.release_stats
    GROUP BY dbid
) recent ON rs.dbid = recent.dbid AND rs.this_release = recent.max_release

pq_v2.question: show release statistics for the most recent release
pq_v2.sql:
SELECT rs.*
FROM rnacen.release_stats rs
JOIN rnacen_django_test.rnc_release rl ON rs.this_release = rl.id
ORDER BY rl.release_date DESC
LIMIT 1

naive.sql:
SELECT
    gta.go_term_annotation_id,
    gta.ontology_term_id,
    gta.evidence_code,
    gta.rna_id,
    rr.pmid
FROM
    rnacen.go_term_annotations gta
JOIN
    rnacen.go_term_publication_map gtpm ON gta.go_term_annotation_id = gtpm.go_term_annotation_id
JOIN
    rnacen.rnc_references rr ON gtpm.reference_id = rr.id

pq_v1.question: publications of GO annotations with their PMID
pq_v1.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    rnc_references.pmid
FROM
    rnacen.go_term_publication_map
JOIN
    rnacen.rnc_references ON go_term_publication_map.reference_id = rnc_references.id
WHERE
    rnc_references.pmid IS NOT NULL

pq_v2.question: publications of GO annotations with their PMID
pq_v2.sql:
SELECT 
  rnacen.go_term_annotations.go_term_annotation_id,
  rnacen_django_test.rnc_references.pmid
FROM 
  rnacen.go_term_annotations
JOIN 
  rnacen.go_term_publication_map 
  ON rnacen.go_term_annotations.go_term_annotation_id = rnacen.go_term_publication_map.go_term_annotation_id
JOIN 
  rnacen_django_test.rnc_references 
  ON rnacen.go_term_publication_map.reference_id = rnacen_django_test.rnc_references.id

raw.question: RNA cross-references with the source database display name

naive.sql:
SELECT rx.dbid, rdb.display_name, rx.upi
FROM rnacen.xref AS rx
JOIN rnacen.rnc_database AS rdb ON rx.dbid = rdb.id

pq_v1.question: RNA cross-references with the source database display name
pq_v1.sql:
SELECT
    rnacen.xref.upi,
    rnacen.xref.ac,
    rnacen.xref.version,
    rnacen.xref.taxid,
    rnacen.rnc_database.display_name
FROM
    rnacen.xref
JOIN
    rnacen.rnc_database ON rnacen.xref.dbid = rnacen.rnc_database.id

pq_v2.question: RNA cross-references with the source database display name
pq_v2.sql:
SELECT
  xref.ac,
  rnc_database.display_name
FROM
  rnacen_django_test.xref
JOIN
  rnacen_django_test.rnc_database ON xref.dbid = rnc_database.id

raw.question: which RNA sequences are predicted to code for proteins

naive.question: which RNA sequences are predicted to code for proteins
naive.sql:
SELECT urs_taxid 
FROM rnacen.cpat_results 
WHERE is_protein_coding = TRUE

pq_v1.question: which RNA sequences are predicted to code for proteins
pq_v1.sql:
SELECT rnacen.rna.upi
FROM rnacen.rna
JOIN rnacen.rnc_sequence_features ON rnacen.rna.upi = rnacen.rnc_sequence_features.upi
WHERE rnacen.rnc_sequence_features.feature_name = 'protein_coding'

pq_v2.question: which RNA sequences are predicted to code for proteins
pq_v2.sql:
SELECT rna.upi, rna.seq_short, rna.seq_long
FROM rnacen.rna
JOIN rnacen.qa_status ON rnacen.qa_status.upi = rna.upi
JOIN rnacen.rnc_rna_precomputed ON rna.upi = rnacen.rnc_rna_precomputed.upi
JOIN rnacen.cpat_results ON rnacen.cpat_results.urs_taxid = rnacen.rnc_rna_precomputed.id
WHERE rnacen.cpat_results.is_protein_coding = TRUE

pq_v1.sql:
SELECT rnc_secondary_structure.secondary_structure
FROM rnacen.rnc_secondary_structure

pq_v2.question: what 2D structures have been predicted for our RNAs
pq_v2.sql:
SELECT r2dt.urs, r2dt.secondary_structure
FROM rnacen.r2dt_results AS r2dt
JOIN rnacen.rna AS rna ON r2dt.urs = rna.upi

pq_v1.sql: SELECT 'insufficient schema: missing literature summaries table' AS error

pq_v2.question: show me literature summaries written about RNA
pq_v2.sql:
SELECT o.summary
FROM rnacen.old_summaries o
WHERE o.context ILIKE '%literature%' AND o.context ILIKE '%RNA%'
UNION
SELECT l.summary
FROM rnacen.litsumm_summaries l
WHERE l.context ILIKE '%literature%' AND l.context ILIKE '%RNA%'

raw.question: which RNAs have been mapped to genome coordinates

naive.question: which RNAs have been mapped to genome coordinates
naive.sql:
SELECT urs_taxid 
FROM rnacen.rnc_rna_precomputed 
WHERE has_coordinates = true

pq_v1.question: which RNAs have been mapped to genome coordinates
pq_v1.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.urs_taxid
FROM rnacen.pipeline_tracking_genome_mapping p
JOIN rnacen.rnc_rna_precomputed r ON p.urs_taxid = r.id
WHERE r.has_coordinates = TRUE

pq_v2.question: which RNAs have been mapped to genome coordinates
pq_v2.sql:
SELECT rnc_rna_precomputed.id, rnc_rna_precomputed.upi
FROM rnacen.rnc_rna_precomputed
JOIN rnacen.rnc_sequence_regions ON rnc_rna_precomputed.id = rnacen.rnc_sequence_regions.urs_taxid
WHERE rnacen.rnc_sequence_regions.was_mapped = true
